note: ⛔ SNG-483. Loose-Limbed — Body's L1 movement craft and the corpus's only escape-from-a-hold. Feeds Skydancer (L4) and Pathless Way (L5).

abilities.name: Loose-Limbed
abilities.narrationHints: They go over the wall the way water goes over a lip — no visible effort, no pause at the top. And the two men holding their arms are holding each other.
abilities.description: Run further and jump farther than a body should, and come out of anything meant to hold you — a grip, a rope, a gap too small.
abilities.notFor: Carrying a load; flight; anything that holds you by something other than your shape — a spell, a weight, a will.

crit.success: You come out of it before the grip has finished closing, and take someone with you.
crit.failure: You fit most of the way through the gap.

bounds.text: ⛔ IT ANSWERS PHYSICAL HOLDS ONLY — rope, hands, bars, a gap. A binding that works on your will or your name is untouched
you cannot carry a pack or a person and do this at r1
⚠️ armour that fits properly is armour that does not let you fold
one escape per hold; a second set of hands is a second problem

abilities.plainly: A chase/escape action that moves you and frees you. Its strength is rated 5 out of 10. Ranks: rank 2 slips bindings and gaps, rank 3 cannot be physically held at all.

sectFlavour.somatic: TRAINED JOINTS AND BREATH — the body is an instrument and this is its range.
sectFlavour.mason: ⚠️ Not this craft. A mason goes THROUGH the wall; a somatic goes over it.

tree.name: Run and Vault
tree.grants: ⛔ COVER GROUND PAST WHAT A BODY SHOULD — a sustained run nobody keeps up with, a standing jump across a street, a wall taken in one movement. ⚠️ AND YOU DO NOT ARRIVE WINDED.
tree.cannot: One burst or one sustained run. No load at this rank.

tree.name: Slip Anything
tree.grants: ⛔ COME OUT OF A GRIP, A GRAPPLE, ROPE, MANACLES OR A PRESS OF BODIES — and fit through a gap a body that size should not fit through: a window slot, a drain, a portcullis gap, a cell bar.
tree.cannot: Physical holds only. A gap must exist; you do not make one.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⛔ ADDS ESCAPE. Come out of a grip, a grapple, rope, manacles or a press of bodies — and fit through a gap a body that size should not fit through: a window slot, a drain, a portcullis gap, a cell bar.

tree.name: Nothing Holds
tree.grants: ⛔ YOU CANNOT BE PHYSICALLY HELD OR CORNERED. Every grip fails as it closes, and you can take one other person out with you.
tree.cannot: One passenger. A hold that is not physical still holds you.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⛔ ADDS PERSISTENCE AND A PASSENGER. You cannot be physically held or cornered — every grip fails as it closes, and you can take one other person out with you.

abilities._authored:
⛔ SNG-483. Erik: 'if you find a place to fit CONTORTIONIST ability — ANTI-BIND, FAST RUNNING and BIG JUMPING — move/travel, let me know.'
⚠️ TWO REAL GAPS AND THEY ARE THE SAME SKILL: (1) NOTHING IN 342 ABILITIES ESCAPES A BIND — fifteen text matches and every one is a door, a seal or a piece of luck, never a person getting out of a hold. (2) SOMATIC HAD NO L1 MOVEMENT CRAFT: Near Way is mason and built-spaces only, then nothing until Skydancer at L4.
⛔ AND IT ANSWERS THE LARGEST COLUMN IN THE GAME. CONTROL is 251 rank-rows corpus-wide and `bind` is most of it. Until now there was no physical counter to being held.

_sng510: ⛔ SNG-510: grants rewritten SELF-CONTAINED. CCode measured that `progression.abilitiesForGM` sends ONLY the rank the player holds — `tree.find(t => t.rank === owned.level)` — so a grant opening 'ADDS RANGE. Throw it' referred to an r1 the model never sees. ⚠️ STRIPPING THE OPENER WAS NOT ENOUGH: 'it' and 'the same force' had no antecedent either. Each rank now names its own craft, its own effect and its own numbers.
_sng523:
⛔ SNG-523: `mechanic.crit` authored. ⚠️ `critFor` HAS EXISTED, WITH A PER-CRAFT CAP AND A STRING SHORTHAND FOR AUTHORS, AND HAS NEVER HAD AN INPUT — 0 of 373. Every critical in the game was generic.
⛔ BOTH HALVES AUTHORED: `success` is what the craft's best case LOOKS LIKE; `failure` is its disaster. ⚠️ MOST CARRY TEXT ONLY — `chance` is opt-in and shifts nothing unless asked for, so a craft can say what its disaster looks like without claiming it happens more often.
